title: TimelineEvent
description: The canonical event (EVENT_MODEL.md §2). Authoritative definition: Rust structs and TypeScript types are generated from this file (ticket P0-003).

id.description: UUIDv7 — time-ordered, producer-generated, used for idempotent ingest.

endTimestamp.description: Epoch milliseconds, UTC. Present for events with duration.

tzOffsetMinutes.description: Local UTC offset at capture time. Required: temporal queries are wrong without it (TR-8).

type.description: Namespaced event type. Unknown types are rejected at ingest, not stored speculatively.

title.description: Redacted before persistence. Sensitive by default outside the safe-app allowlist (PRIVACY.md §3.3).

metadata.description: Type-specific payload, validated against the per-type schema at ingest.

redaction.description: Proof that redaction ran. Persistence rejects events without it (PRIVACY.md §4.2).

applied.description: Detector ids that fired. Never the matched values.

searchableText.description: Assembled by the normaliser only. A producer cannot smuggle unredacted text into the index.
